node.statement: Starting from the positive finite scalars of (1.1), the serial definitions in (1.2) make C_Delta', C_Delta, C_2, and C_3 finite positive, and make rho_unit, rho_id, rho_prod, rho_Delta', rho_Delta, rho_2, rho_DeltaPhi, and rho_3 positive: sums and positive integer multiples preserve finite positivity, reciprocals have strictly positive denominators, and every displayed minimum has finitely many positive entries. These derived scalars remain independent of all input data.
